scope: Forty high-impact Europe P0 candidates closest to the strict publication gate after the fourth-round master disposition
method: Candidate-by-candidate verification against official faculty rosters, university-hosted profiles and CVs, official doctoral registries, lab people pages, university project pages, and manually inspected portrait files. The strict gate was unchanged.
